# pixiv Comic (pixivコミック) fixtures

`captured-work.json`, `series.html`, and `reader.html` project the 2026-10-25 capture of work `9830`, 嘆きの亡霊は引退したい ～最弱ハンターによる最強パーティ育成術～, and episode `154853`. They retain metadata, catalog order, access state, and all 21 declared page paths and dimensions. Reader DOM preserves the background-image containers consumed by the integration.

Executable scripts, advertising, account/session data, and image bytes have been removed. Request salt and image keys are synthetic. Deterministic downloads pair the captured manifest with generated 64×64 PNG pixels to exercise grid reconstruction. The second navigation work and page manifests for uncaptured episodes are explicit synthetic controls.
